correctness.rationale: For arbitrary \(N\ge4\) and \(1\le k\le N-1\), the only nondecaying no-jump vectors are H-invariant vectors in ker n_0. The hard-core-boson cross block is the Boolean down operator \(D_k\) and its kernel is automatically a Johnson eigenspace; the up/down commutator proves its exact rank. Fermionic second quantization splits into 0/1 occupancy of a single uniform orbital, and contraction at the lossy site proves the exact exterior-power dark dimension. Both yield the stated capture formulas. The included standalone script constructs 66 independent finite Hamiltonian sectors and 48 time-evolution checks, all passed. These checks corroborate rather than replace the all-size proof.

value.rationale: The first-loss fate of an initial k-particle ensemble is a natural physical transport observable. Two exchange-statistics conventions produce a provably different dark fraction on the identical complete network, with a sharp bosonic half-filling saturation and a fermionic survival fraction approaching one quarter there. These exact all-filling predictions and their invariant-subspace mechanism give a nonroutine, experimentally interpretable boundary for statistics-sensitive collective loss, not merely a renamed Johnson eigenvalue.
